name: clinic-grower-internal-crm-backend
description: Backend for the Clinic Grower internal CRM, built on Express, TypeScript, and Node.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: NODE_ENV=test node --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 scripts/backup-db-options.test.mjs scripts/backup-restore-hardening.test.mjs dist/test/test-csv.js dist/test/test-export-validators.js dist/test/test-contact-pagination.js dist/test/test-command-palette.js dist/test/test-internal-delivery-tasks.js dist/test/test-strategy-logs.js dist/test/test-sops.js dist/test/test-client-accounts.js dist/test/test-client-operating-register.js dist/test/test-lead-hub.js dist/test/test-landing-page-lead-intake.js dist/test/test-observability.js dist/test/test-proposals-public.js dist/test/test-proposals.js dist/test/test-roles-management.js dist/test/test-scoro-import-templates.js dist/test/test-tenant-permission-coverage.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test dist/test/test-internal-delivery-tasks.js dist/test/test-strategy-logs.js dist/test/test-sops.js dist/test/test-client-accounts.js dist/test/test-performance-os-chain.js
scripts.test:clickup: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-clickup-mappings.js dist/test/test-clickup-operating-model.js
scripts.test:ai-safety: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-ai-safety-policy.js && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-ai-chat-assistant.js && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-ai-evaluations.js
scripts.test:lead-ingestion: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-unified-lead-ingestion-contract.js && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-integration-inputs.js && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-landing-page-lead-intake.js && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/test-email-lead-ingestion.js
scripts.test:security: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none dist/test/test-secret-config.js dist/test/test-tenant-permission-coverage.js && npm run security:scan
scripts.test:scoro-import: npm run build && node --test dist/test/test-scoro-import-templates.js dist/test/test-scoro-import-foundation.js
